services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Mahayla Kemble
reviews.text: Very bad company and not professional. My car was sitting there for months without them touching it, the only thing they did was open the door of the car. I was calling frequently and they said they were going to start working on it and that kept going for 1 month of them saying “they’ll get to it”. I got it towed back to my house and they gave me attitude about it.

reviews.author: Crissie Watkins
reviews.text: My husband took his 2017 Chevrolet to Barry's tranmission almost 6 months ago with a bad transmission. They replaced it and have stood behind their work. Very thankful for their services.

reviews.author: Charity Gurley
reviews.text: Mr. Barry and his staff are honest, trustworthy, professional, and dependable. He stands behind his work and takes pride in his work. I was stranded after I got off the Pee Dee Bridge. I called Mr. Barry and he came immediately and towed my car. He even asked did I need a ride to work, and that was something he definitely did not have to do. I don't worry about getting ripped off or taken advantage of. I would recommend him, hands down, to anyone!

reviews.author: Mike Krantz
reviews.text: Great people, Chris is great, took our F250 there for power steering problems, they gave us a quote, communicated the progress all the time, kept us informed, called us a few days later that it was ready, was under the quote, had no way to pick the truck up, came and got us. What more can you ask for. Chris was recommended by another business owner in Marion, Chris is our goto mechanic.

reviews.author: Sarah Mack
reviews.text: Barry's did a rear-end over houl on my 2005 Ford f150. I were a little uneasy about anyone working on any vehicle of mine, because my husband were the best machine I known, for over 38 years I never been to a machine shop. Berry did a great job and I am going to take all my vehicles to him. He is the second best side my be love husband (Curtis).RIP

reviews.author: Gina D
reviews.text: I wouldn't rank this place as 1 star but u have to put one star at least but this place is a joke and the "new" owner Cameron and Barry are not professional at all. They don't know how to speak to customers or handle things professionally. They will let your stuff get stolen and not do anything about it. But that was ended and o well our loss right but went back to do business still and they got attitude and didn't want to do work because a previous situation that happened to us there before and our loss. Crazy right u talk to people and turn down business because of someone stealing ur stuff from there wouldn't recommend this place to anyone

reviews.author: Michael Mckinley
reviews.text: This is one of the most helpful mechanics I've ever been too . We were a family of six and they came and got us off the side of the road towed and fixed our car for us immediately and gave us a very fair price . They were kind and very professional. I would recommend them to anyone and again thank you guys for all your help.

reviews.author: Matthew Hackney
reviews.text: Rips people off. Consumers beware! I know a lot about vehicles and normally do my own work on them. However I did not have the time to swap out a transmission under warranty so I paid them to do it. The vehicle is now worse off then it was when I brought it to them!

reviews.author: Allen Lowrimore
reviews.text: My experience has been great. The service has been really helpful. These guys are going above and beyond. I greatly appreciate the effort they are putting in. They aren't doing unnecessary things or tests.

reviews.author: Brianna LeSage
reviews.text: We were on vaccation and having troubles with our Jeep on the way home and happened to come through Marion...we then went to Barry’s and seen if he could help and he said he had time and then we had told him about the temperature light coming on and he said he was going to flush the transmission, and put 7.3L of CTV +4 and said he was charging us 160$ and then after all the work was done he tried saying actually it was 223$ and we are a young’s. Couple and didn’t have much to spare as we had to get home from vaccation and we got an hour down the road when the problem was happening again and we had to pull over about every 20 minutes on a 14 hour drive as we didn’t have money now to go to another mechanic and finally once we hit Ohio on our way back we stopped at oreillys auto parts and the store manager and assistant manager are mechanic and did the 160$ job they did for free and seen he put RTV oil in our air filter and Cocked it so we could make it just enough time down the road... DO NOT GO TO HIM HE WILL DO ANYTHING JUST FOR MONEY! Oreillys luckily had a mechanic who knew what he was doing and fixed our car for us!!! Thank god that there’s still good people in the world! Always check an auto parts store first!!!!!

reviews.author: Wendy Wilhelm
reviews.text: No appointment was necessary. Very quick service. Dropped my vehicle off early afternoon and was able to pick it back up before they closed for the day.

reviews.author: Michael Jordan
reviews.text: A total rip off i needed transmission line replaced andplaa fitting. He insisted on replacing lines, 4 fittings radiator just to start. Turning a 200 job into a 700. I told him not to do the work so he charges 40 bucks for an estimat e. Must've been make work day.

reviews.author: Ashley Sullivan
reviews.text: Hands down you will not find anyone to take care of your vehicles like these guys do. They are knowledgeable, kind, and fast! I won’t take my car any place else!

reviews.author: kevin norkus
reviews.text: Barry knows his stuff and would highly recommend anyone to his auto shop for repairs and service. Honest and trustworthy!

reviews.author: Maria Moranchel
reviews.text: The best place for your automotive needs!! No need to worry about being taken to the cleaners like most other auto shops.
